# GSC — Git Security Checker

> SAST-сканер с доказательством эксплойтов (PoC), верификацией фиксов
> (Proof-of-Fix) и self-healing CI. GitHub Action + движок в Docker-образе.

This file is for AI agents and LLM crawlers. Human docs: [README.md](README.md).

## What it does

- **69 detectors** — SAST, SCA (OSV.dev), Secrets, IaC
- **PoC auto-generation** — рабочий эксплойт, доказывающий находку
- **Proof-of-Fix** — патч считается исправлением только если эксплойт перестал срабатывать
- **Self-healing CI** — авто-PR с фиксом (только CLI, требует явного флага)

## How to use it (pick one)

### 1. GitHub Action — one file, zero config

```yaml
# .github/workflows/gsc.yml
name: GSC Audit
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: poliakarmai/gsc@v1
        with:
          fail_on_critical: false
```

Runs on every PR. Posts a comment with findings and a security score.

Note: `branches:` must match your default branch. If it is `develop` or
`release`, add that name — otherwise the workflow silently never fires.

### 2. CLI (Docker)

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" -w /repo \
  ghcr.io/poliakarmai/gsc-scanner:v1 scan . --ci --json
```

Other commands: `gsc --help` (≈80 subcommands: `sca`, `iac`, `secrets`,
`sbom`, `pof`, `archaeology`, `forecast`, `federated`, `compliance`).

## Action inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `.` | Path to scan |
| `deep_scan` | `true` | Deep scan (Echelon 4, slower) |
| `fail_on_critical` | `false` | Exit 1 on CRITICAL findings |
| `fail_on_score` | `0` | Exit 1 if score < threshold. `0` = off, range 1–100 |
| `max_findings_to_comment` | `10` | Rows shown per section in the PR comment |
| `llm_api_key` | `''` | BYO-LLM key for revalidation (without it: regex-only) |
| `llm_base_url` | `''` | OpenAI-compatible endpoint (DeepSeek/OpenRouter/Ollama) |
| `llm_model` | `''` | Model name for revalidation |
| `sarif` | `false` | Also emit SARIF for GitHub Code Scanning |
| `reachability` | `false` | Down-rank findings in unreachable files (import graph) |

Outputs: `score` (0–100), `grade` (A+ … F).

## MCP (AI coding agents)

The MCP server is **not available yet**. It lives in the closed-source engine
and is not shipped in the public image — Claude Code / Cursor cannot connect to
it today. Do not instruct users to configure an MCP server for GSC.

Agents should use the Action or the CLI above instead.

## Licensing (matters for agents generating advice)
